final_message:
Configured the 31 authoritative zones and 30 delegations across pc1–pc31. pc32 (`10.15.8.14`) is the recursive resolver, and the PC startup files point their resolvers to it. The existing links, IP addresses, and routing were preserved.

The zone files include the requested glue, `www.example.com`, and the two MX and mail A records. Static checks passed for all zone declarations, delegations, glue records, and PC startup script syntax.

The hierarchy has **not yet been validated at runtime**. The [Kathara creation skill](/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-2t28vzod/lab/.codex/skills/kathara-creation/SKILL.md) says to “await user request to validate it” after generating a scenario, so runtime validation requires your request. BIND’s configuration-checking tools were also unavailable in the local environment.
